The security layer operates before the LLM: unit and integration tests cover pattern detection and permission logic, with a live E2E only to verify that hostile messages are stopped before model execution and normal messages receive clearance.

snapshot.agent_state: The coding agent has committed to a pre-model, rule-based design. It treats prompt injection as something detectable from the current raw message using regex/pattern rules and tool risk tiers. It is explaining this architecture before implementation begins; no LLM reviewer has been proposed.
snapshot.agent_last_message: The design is a defensive gate in front of the model: inspect the incoming message, classify its risk, block or quarantine obvious attacks, and issue a clearance token before tools may execute. The proposed tests use a corpus of known injection strings plus token and permission checks.
